subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**promotes**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the role of Lactobacillus in the formation of curd.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate a positive action Lactobacillus has on curd formation.
 
• "**Promotes**" fits well as it denotes the enhancement or support of the process, aligning with the context of curd formation.
 
• Other options ("**lead**", "**help**", "**cause**") do not precisely fit the context in the way "**promotes**" does.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Curd contains several microorganisms. Of these, the bacterium, Lactobacillus promotes__ the formation of curd. It multiplies in milk and ___ (2) ____ it into curd. Bacteria are also involved in the ____ (3) ____ of cheese, pickles and many other food items. Bacteria and yeast are also helpful for the fermentation of rice idlis and dosa batter. Yeast ____(4)____ rapidly and produces carbon dioxide during respiration. Bubbles of the gas fill the dough and increase its ____(5)____ . This is the basis of the use of yeast in the baking industry for making bread, pastries and cakes.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lead**: "Lead" implies guiding or being in charge. It does not fit as well as "promotes" in this context.
 
• **Help**: "Help" means assist, which is similar but not as specific as "promotes" for this context.
 
• **Cause**: "Cause" means to make happen, which can be ambiguous in the context.
